Financial Reporting and Analysis · Creating regular financial reports that include income statements, profit and loss accounts, balance sheets, cash flow statements etc for the client as well as management. · Adherence to the tasks scheduled in the Cadence Report. · Timely delivery of deliverables within cost to the client's satisfaction. · Preparing and maintaining accurate accounting records, ensuring all financial transactions are properly documented and recorded. ii. Compliance and Risk Management · Ensure compliance with financial regulations, company policies, client requirements and industry standards. · Help identify and assess financial and operational risks to be faced by the company or project, suggesting mitigation strategies. vii. Collaboration and Communication · Collaborate with cross-functional teams, ensuring smooth communication between finance, operations, and other departments. · Provide administrative support for finance-related tasks as needed. Required Skills and Qualifications · Graduate or postgraduate in Commerce, CMA, or ACCA qualified. · 1+ years of experience in accounting, or a related role. · Experience in Financial Data Analytics is an added advantage. · Experience in real estate accounting is preferred but not essential. · Should be flexible to work night shifts, as required. · Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities. · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. · Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word techniques. · Familiarity with financial software and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks, Tally etc.) is a plus. · Basic understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and reporting. · Attention to detail and the ability to work with large sets of data. · Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
